records.text: Silver Works still hasn't created a project a week in, flagging for outreach

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Works set up
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone. Two Wrenfield emails unanswered ([email:77f771b5], [email:fe7beffc]) and a no-show welcome call ([calendar:5f1a1cba]); zero customer-initiated contact or tickets. No signal of self-driven momentum in the remaining 8 days, though Team plan implies real intent.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your first project?
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Sorry we missed each other for the welcome call last week -- happy to find another time that works better for you.

If it's useful, I can walk you through setting up your first real project in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that first one usually makes everything else click. And whenever you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week suit? Just reply with a day and I'll work around you.

Best,
Priya
